title: The Kvass Mod
description: The Kvass Mod brings kvass to Minecraft.
body:
### 🍺 Kvass Mod
This mod adds the Kvass drink to Minecraft.

## What does it add?
This mod adds 4 types of kvass:
- Kvass Taras
- Monastirskij Kvass
- Zheltaja Bochka
- Lidskij Kvass
- 
All 4 give different effects and are all brewed using different ingredients.

## How to make them?
Alongside the beverages, this mod adds a _**kvass brewing machine**_, in which you are able to put 2 necessary items and one ingredient of your choice. 
You need to add water and a empty kvass bottle, and also one of four ingredients.

## Kvass Recipes
- Kvass Taras - _Bread_
- Monastirskij Kvass - _Sugar_
- Zheltaja Bochka - _Honeycomb_
- Lidskij Kvass - _Wheat_

## EXTRA INFO
The brewing machine takes 10 seconds to brew the Kvass, when it's done, it will light up. If you placed the wrong ingredients in the brewing machine, crouch and right click to take them out.

The crafting recipes are provided in the _images_ section.

To brew the Zheltaja Bochka, you will need to use a _Big Kvass Bottle_ instead of a regular _Kvass Bottle_.
